verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਕੁਲਾ ਬਧੂ ਬੁਧਿਵੰਤ ਸਸੁਰਾਰ ਬਿਖੈ ਸਾਵਧਾਨ ਚੇਤਨ ਰਹੈ ਅਚਾਰ ਚਾਰ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise kulaa badhoo budhiva(n)t sasuraar bikhai saavadhaan chetan rahai achaar chaar kai ||

en.bdb: Just as an intelligent daughter-in-law of a good family deals with everybody attentively, consciously and decently in her in-laws house;

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਸੁਰ ਦੇਵਰ ਜੇਠ ਸਕਲ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੈ ਖਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਜਾਨਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਰਵਾਰ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: sasur dhevar jeTh sakal kee sevaa karai khaan paan giaan jaan pat paravaar kai ||

en.bdb: Realizing that this is her husband's family, takes care of food and all other needs of her father-in-law, brothers-in-law and other members of the family diligently and respectfully;

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਧੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਗੁਰ ਜਨ ਸੈ ਲਜਾ ਲਵੰਨਿ ਸਿਹਿਜਾ ਸਮੈ ਰਸ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਤਾਰ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: madhur bachan gur jan sai lajaa lava(n)n sihijaa samai ras prem pooran bhataar kai ||

en.bdb: She talks with all elders of the family respectfully, politely and abashedly. Similarly a devoted disciple of the True Guru is adept in observing respect towards all human beings.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸਰਬਾਤਮ ਪੂਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਬੀਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਧਿਆਨ ਗੁਰ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਪਾਰ ਕੈ ॥੩੯੫॥
verses.translit_en: taise gursikh sarabaatam poojaa prabeen braham dhiaan gur moorat apaar kai ||395||

en.bdb: But within himself, he remains focused on the divine sight of the God-like True Guru. (According to Bhai Gurdas Ji, practicing on the Guru's words and meditating on Lord's name given by the True Guru is contemplation on the vision of True Guru).  (395)
